The tetragonal crystal Ba₂Zn₃C₄ (space group I4₁/a, No. 143) has 36 atoms per unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows carbon centers with two Zn neighbors (1.80–1.85 Å) or four Ba neighbors (2.91–3.01 Å), while Zn centers coordinate to one C neighbor and Ba centers have nine geometric neighbors (four Ba and five C). The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 36 sites, and validated polyhedron contacts include corner-sharing between Ba and C polyhedra and corner- and edge-sharing between Ba polyhedra.
